hero.body: Kenya's public money moves fast, and mostly out of sight. We track it nationally and in select counties — turning opaque fiscal policy into verified intelligence for partners, institutions, and newsrooms.

storyIntro.body: House of Fiscal Wisdom with Dr. Lyla Latif — forensic briefing on illicit financial flows, produced with Wanahabari Lab as evidence partners can brief against.

programmesStrip.description: Connect, Mashinani, and Wanahabari — with production and commissions captured through BNS Studio.

team.description: A dedicated group of researchers, storytellers, and tech innovators working together to bring transparency to Kenya's public budgets.

gallery.description: Moments from civic workshops, town halls, and community engagements across the country.

studioStrip.description: Browse commissioned podcasts, documentaries, animations, and civic campaigns organised by content type and organisation — every project helps fund Kenya's leading youth budget platform.
studioStrip.highlight: Every commission is double impact: evidence-based content for your audience, with proceeds reinvested into Budget Ndio Story's civic mission.
